findings.detail: In the shared main tree (dirty with C2/C4 in-flight edits) the test failed 3 times with varying symptoms: pick() found no seated+frontier pair once, and twice the frontier click selected a neighbouring piece (wi:...:20141 instead of 20132) although the pointer hover showed the right plate and elementFromPoint was the canvas. In a throwaway worktree at clean c212105, `npm run e2e:spec -- solar` passed twice (37 passed, incl. :352) and `e2e:keystone` passed (43; one earlier keystone run had 1 unattributed failure, not repeated). So the cause is the working tree's uncommitted edits or timing noise, not B1 (T4 rest), B2 (one-line plate, list grace) or B3/B4. The 22bde78 baseline run was killed by the orchestrator restart, so no per-commit bisect was completed; unnecessary given HEAD passes.
